tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The HP 560SFP+ 10Gbps 2-Port PCI Ethernet Adapter (HP 665247-001) is a high-performance network adapter designed for enterprise and data center applications. Delivering ultra-fast 10Gbps connectivity over SFP+ interfaces, this adapter ensures low latency, high throughput, and reliable network performance. Compatible with standard PCI slots, it’s ideal for upgrading servers and workstations requiring high-speed network access.


Key Features:


  • Dual-port 10Gbps SFP+ Ethernet connectivity
  • High-performance PCI interface for servers and workstations
  • Low-latency, high-throughput design for enterprise networks
  • Reliable network performance for data-intensive applications
  • Compatible with HP servers and standard PCI slots
